card.name: Quranic verse commentary on divine consequence
card.fires_on: Small linking words inside quoted or paraphrased Quranic verses about wrongdoing, divine help and punishment, such as "who", "to", "what" and "have". The setting is a religious commentary on earlier peoples and messengers.

modes.label: Relative "who"
modes.description: The word "who" after "those" in verses about evil plotting or helping Allah.
modes.example: But evil plotting envelops only those<< who>> do it.

modes.label: Verbs and particles in conditionals
modes.description: Small words inside "if only... We would have opened up to them" style verses.
modes.example: We would have opened up<< to>> them blessings from heaven and earth.

card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in Quranic verses about people who reject warnings and the consequences that follow.
evidence: But evil plotting envelops only those<< who>> do it.
We would have opened up<< to>> them blessings from heaven and earth.
But they denied the truth so We seized them for<< what>> they earned.
